checklist.task: Verify legal entity names and state of incorporation (Apex Innovations Inc. & Horizon Analytics LLC)
Define specific boundaries for disclosed technical secrets to ensure clarity on what constitutes Confidential Information
Establish internal tracking mechanism for marking electronic files and documents as 'Confidential'
Confirm team members who will have access to counterparty materials are briefed on 5-year non-disclosure terms
Evaluate whether San Francisco, CA arbitration venue is cost-feasible or propose virtual hearing stipulations
Confirm authorized signatory holds officer-level signing capacity (CEO / Managing Director)

deadlines.deadline: Within 30 calendar days upon written demand

lawyer_questions: Does our existing IP portfolio contain trade secrets that could be compromised under the 'AS IS' warranty disclaimer?
Should we negotiate a carve-out for residual knowledge retained in human memory without bad-faith intent?
Is the waiver of injunction bonding customary in this jurisdiction or does it expose us to disproportionate leverage?
Can we amend the dispute clause to mandate non-binding mediation before escalating to expensive AAA arbitration?
Does the definition of Confidential Information require marking in writing within 30 days for oral disclosures?
Are our independent contractors and fractional consultants sufficiently covered under the permitted recipient group?
Does California Labor Code Section 16600 or recent FTC guidance affect any implied restrictive covenants in this agreement?
What specific protocol should we follow to certify electronic record destruction given automated cloud backup snapshots?
